title: Charge the uniform perfect-matching posterior after sampling the monomer set
statement: For monomers U(M) and pm(H) the perfect-matching count, Pr(U(M)=U)=lambda^((n-|U|)/2)*pm(G[V\U])/Z_G(lambda) when n-|U| is even. Given a supported U, the residual matching is uniform over perfect matchings of G[V\U]. A correct monomer sample therefore leaves this full conditional matching sampler, including its work and depth, to be implemented. Monomer covariance or partition-function estimates alone do not pay that operation.
